description: Find Google Ads Transparency AR… entities — ranked multi-result (1 credit when found; empty is free). Costs 1 credit. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code used for ranking (e.g. US). Default US.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 10, max 50). Flat 1 credit when results are returned; 0 credits when totalReturned is 0.

q.description: Brand, domain, or advertiser name (min 2 characters). Expanded + ranked so US prefers Inc. over SRL.

name: google_ad_library_advertiser_search
title: Google Advertiser Search
